_about: Integration settings for routing preterm / low-birth-weight infants between the preterm engine and the under-5 engine. Separate from preterm_rules.json, which is kept exactly as supplied. Every value tagged 'proposed' needs clinician sign-off and is meant to be changed here, not in code.

plausible_ga_weeks.tag: proposed: Fenton starts at 22 weeks; the upper bound is an input sanity limit

plausible_weights.tag: proposed: unit guards only. weight_kg is kilograms and birth_weight_g is grams; a swap (1.1 g, 1250 kg) is rejected, not converted. Needs clinician sign-off.

use_until_chronological_months.tag: approved 2026-11-08 by Edison: based on the clinical guidelines. Add "provisional": true to show a provisional warning again.

level_map._note: Preterm referral level -> under-5 tier. The under-5 engine has no follow-up tier, so follow_up has NO under-5 tier (null): the response keeps preterm_level 'follow_up' as its own disposition. No level was invented and follow_up is not forced into mam or low_risk (decision 2026-11-08).

oedema_on_preterm_route.tag: approved 2026-11-08, per Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) Guidelines, Malawi, 2016, Table 5 as encoded in rules_v2016.py: any bilateral pitting oedema in an infant under 6 months (INF.OEDEMA) and oedema +++ at any age (NRU.OEDEMA3) are inpatient criteria. Oedema is a clinical sign, not a growth measure. Per-grade values can be lowered here if the clinicians decide otherwise.

hypoglycaemia.tag: approved 2026-11-08, per Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) Guidelines, Malawi, 2016, Table 5: hypoglycaemia is a listed medical complication (inpatient care), so the complications value hypoglycaemia is the urgent trigger on the preterm route. Set false to require the explicit hypoglycaemia_not_correcting field instead.
